SI1.name: Instructional Clarity
SI1.description: Teacher clearly states the lesson goal

resources.title: 5 step lesson plan
resources.rationale: Root fix for vague or absent goals. If teacher cannot plan, they cannot state goals.

resources.title: Quick checks for understanding
resources.rationale: Once planning habit is forming, add quick checks to confirm students understand the goal.

resources.title: Blooms Taxonomy
resources.rationale: If SI1 still failing after planning + checks, teacher needs depth in goal-setting.

resources.title: 5 step lesson plan
resources.rationale: No lesson architecture = no flow. Start with basic planning structure.

resources.title: Using Varied Strategies to Build Connected Lessons
resources.rationale: If flow is still poor after planning is addressed, multi-lesson sequencing forces deliberate transition design across a unit.

resources.title: Number Sense
resources.rationale: Number/operations errors — most common in mathematics content.

resources.title: Phonic strategies part 1
resources.rationale: Phonics errors — most common in literacy content.

resources.title: بھاری اور ہلکی آوازیں (Heavy and Light Sounds)
resources.rationale: Letter/sound errors — most common in Urdu language content.

PIC-1.name: Activities & Tasks Alignment
PIC-1.description: Activities match learning objectives and cognitive demands

resources.title: 5 step lesson plan
resources.rationale: Alignment fails first because there is no planning habit linking objective to activity. Same video as SI1 Obs 3.

resources.title: Blooms Taxonomy
resources.rationale: If basic planning is forming but cognitive level is mismatched, Bloom's gives the framework to align task demand to objective verb. Shared: SI1 Obs 5.

resources.title: Five step lesson plan
resources.rationale: Requires the teacher to actively design alignment — producing a plan where objective and activity are explicitly matched.

resources.title: Misconceptions in basic operations
resources.rationale: [Math] Most direct match for math misconception handling. Gives teacher a taxonomy of common errors and correct responses.

resources.title: Common Misconceptions about Science-1
resources.domain: Science in Personal and Social Perspective
resources.rationale: [Science] Explores prevalent misconceptions and incorrect beliefs students may hold.

resources.title: Common Misconceptions about Science-2
resources.domain: Science in Personal and Social Perspective
resources.rationale: [Science] Address and correct these misunderstandings through targeted instruction.

PIC-4.name: Quality Questioning
PIC-4.description: Teacher uses open-ended and probing questions

resources.title: Open-Ended Questions
resources.rationale: Entry point for all questioning failures. Provides question stems. Must come before any other questioning skill.

resources.title: Use Socratic Questioning
resources.rationale: If teacher asks open questions but never probes deeper, Socratic questioning builds the follow-up as the core questioning move.

resources.title: Bloom's Taxonomy
resources.rationale: Designing questions in advance at multiple cognitive levels makes deliberate probing a planned act. Shared: PIC-1 Obs 4.

PIA-3.name: Catering to Learning Levels
PIA-3.description: Teacher differentiates instruction for different student levels

resources.title: Small Steps, Big Success
resources.rationale: Most achievable differentiation in large classrooms — verbal adjustments only, no extra materials.

resources.title: Universal Design for Learning: Teaching for Every Child
resources.rationale: If scaffolding habit is not forming, UDL provides the planning framework for designing lessons for diversity.

resources.title: Design and Assign differentiated Instructional Activities
resources.rationale: Move from verbal scaffolding to structured task differentiation.

resources.title: Differentiated assessments
resources.rationale: If differentiation still absent at assessment stage — different ways to demonstrate learning.

PIA-4.name: Responsive Re-explanation
PIA-4.description: Teacher explains differently when students don't understand
PIA-4.gapNote: No LO exists for alternative explanation strategies (analogy, diagram, different example). Escalate to coach through nudge.

M1.name: Mathematical Discourse & Reasoning
M1.description: Students justify solutions and explain mathematical thinking

resources.title: Misconceptions in basic operations
resources.rationale: No dedicated math discourse LO. Best entry — gives practical reason to ask 'why does that work?' Shared: PIC-3 Obs 3.

resources.title: Use Socratic Questioning
resources.rationale: Closest available — probing follow-ups after student responses. Not math-specific but builds the probing habit. Shared: PIC-4 Obs 5.

resources.title: Encouraging Multiple Solutions in the Classroom
resources.rationale: Multiple solution approaches IS the core of mathematical discourse.

resources.title: Phonic strategies part 1
resources.rationale: No pedagogical workaround substitutes for phonics knowledge. Most direct entry for English. Shared: SI3 Obs 3 [English].

resources.title: Blending and Segmenting
resources.rationale: If sounds taught but blending absent, this addresses blending and segmentation methodology.

resources.title: Key components of phonological awareness
resources.rationale: Conceptual map of how sounds work in English.

resources.title: اردو کی حرکات (Harakaat)
resources.rationale: Harakaat IS Urdu phonics — equivalent of sound-letter correspondence. Shared: SI3 Obs 3 [Urdu].

resources.title: ارکان سازی (Arkaan Saazi)
resources.rationale: Urdu blending — equivalent of English blending methodology.

S1.name: Inquiry-Based Approach
S1.description: Teacher uses inquiry before explanation in science

resources.title: Inquiry-based learning
resources.rationale: No L0/L1 LO exists. L2 only direct match — structurally requires starting with a question. Shared: PIA-2 Obs 5.

resources.title: Peer Problem-Solving
resources.rationale: Safer format — students grapple with scenario together before teacher explains.

resources.title: Open-Ended Questions
resources.rationale: Stepping back: if L2 inquiry not landing, the prerequisite skill of open questioning may be missing. Shared: PIC-4 Obs 3.
